answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, unlocked only after continuous uptime, rewards vest against future work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the nebula of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Each submission hangs on the knoll of a task receipt, and the inlet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
